Each product's own % (the site's price vs compare-at) stays the product's offer: the Hobo Bag is still '50% off', the 60% is only ever said of buying 2 or 3 bags together ('up to 60% off'). A new sale: add a campaign with the client's words in 'approved'. final_sale: the sale's items cannot be returned (its terms page), so no returns promise while it runs (compliance, ad copy, scripts).
